title: 43 Sand Hill Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 43 Sand Hill Circle is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included (12 Wristbands) Located Directly in Front of the Frog Pool, Green Space, and Swings Parking for 2 Vehicles 6 Adult Bikes for Easy Exploring 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Natural Gas Grill + Exterior Shower Expansive Wraparound Porches & Private Balconies Detached Carriage House with Full Living Quarters Just 2 Minutes by Bike to Camp WaterColor 4 Minutes to WaterColor Beach Club via Scenic Western Lake Bridge 7 Minutes by Cart to Iconic Seaside DETAILS: 43 Sandhill Circle delivers the best of WaterColor living through timeless design and everyday comfort. The first floor features a bright, open layout where the living room, dining area, and chef’s kitchen flow easily together. High-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and ample workspace make the kitchen ideal for preparing family meals. This level also includes a laundry area, a king guest suite with a private bath, and an additional guest room with a twin-over-queen bunk. A full bathroom with a walk-in shower completes the floor. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a king bed, private balcony, and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Nearby, a spacious bunk room sleeps four comfortably with a twin-over-twin bunk, a twin bed, and a trundle—complete with its own bathroom. Another king suite with a private bath and a dedicated home office round out the second floor. The detached carriage house functions as a private suite, offering a king bedroom, living area, full kitchen, and a walk-in shower—perfect for grandparents, a nanny, or guests who appreciate extra space and privacy. Outside, wraparound porches and private balconies provide inviting spots to relax throughout the day. After the beach, guests can grill out on the natural gas grill and enjoy dinner outdoors. Six adult bikes and a six-passenger electric cart make it easy to explore the community, whether you’re heading to Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, or the shops of Seaside. This home balances convenience with the quiet beauty that defines WaterColor’s Lake District.
